---
format: html
---

$TB = RL * NR * 2 (if\ paired-end)$

<font color='grey'>

* TB: Total bases
* RL: Read length
* NR: No. of reads

</font>

$AP = RT * {{100 - HC} \over 100}$

<font color='grey'>

* AP: Actual % in DNA
* RT: Relative abundance of species in microbiome (%)
* HC: Host contamination (%)

</font>

$Coverage\ X= {TB \over GS} * {AP \over 100}$

<font color='grey'>

* GS: Genome size in bases

</font>
